sections.title: Prerequisite Review: Determinants as Area
lecture_lines: Determinants measure the area of parallelograms.
Columns of A define a base parallelogram.
Determinants represent this total signed area.
animations: Show 2D parallelogram with area=|det(A)| using #FFFFFF labels.
Highlight vectors forming the sides with colors #FF5733 and #33FF57.
Transition parallelogram to show area scaling factor using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg].

sections.title: Visualizing the Linear System
lecture_lines: Represent Ax = b as vector combinations.
Basis vectors a1 and a2 reach b.
Find x and y scaling factors.
animations: Visualize vector b as sum of columns of A.
Color column vector a1 as #FF5733 and a2 as #33FF57.
Show scaling coefficients x1 and x2 as sliding bars using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/slider.svg].

sections.title: Geometric Derivation of Cramer's Rule
lecture_lines: Replace column a1 with target vector b.
New parallelogram formed by b and a2.
Ratio of areas gives scaling factor x.
Cramer's Rule equals area ratio calculation.
animations: Display area spanned by (b, a2) as area = |det(b, a2)| [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/grid.svg].
Overlay area spanned by (a1, a2) as area = |det(a1, a2)|.
Equate ratios to solve for variable x1 [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/calculator.svg].
Demonstrate x1 = det(b, a2) / det(a1, a2).
Generalize result to higher dimensions with flashing #FFFF00 [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/protractor.svg].

sections.title: Summary and Intuition
lecture_lines: Cramer's rule is geometric area scaling.
Each factor represents an area ratio.
Intuitive way to solve linear systems.
animations: Display final Cramer's Rule formula using #FFFFFF font. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg]
Animate transformation of area into system solution.
Flash the rule for emphasis using #FFFF00. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg]
